description_en: Associates a Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance with shared Express Connect circuits. This API is used to migrate an existing VBR that was pushed cross-account to shared Express Connect circuits (shared port), completing the shared Express Connect circuits form transformation. Only the partner (Express Connect circuit owner) can call this operation
description_zh:
关联边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）实例至共享专线。
该API用于将「推送跨账号 VBR」方式下的存量 VBR 迁移至共享专线（共享端口），完成共享专线形态转换。仅合作伙伴（物理专线拥有者）调用
kebab_example: aliyun vpc attach-vbr-to-vpconn --vpconn-id pc-bp1mrgfbtmc9brre70000 --vbr-id vbr-bp133sn3nwjvu7twc0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachVbrToVpconn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shared Express Connect circuits (VirtualPhysicalConnection) instance.
The shared Express Connect circuits instance ID returned by CreateVpconnFromVbr. The instance must have been confirmed and accepted by the tenant (Confirmed) and be in the Enabled state
parameters.help_zh:
共享专线（VirtualPhysicalConnection）实例ID。
CreateVpconnFromVbr 返回的共享专线实例 ID，须已被租户确认接收（Confirmed）并处于 Enabled 状态
parameters.name: vpconn_id

parameters.help_en:
The VBR instance ID.
The ID of the VBR instance to be migrated. The VBR must currently be directly attached to an Express Connect circuit owned by the caller, and must be the same VBR specified in CreateVpconnFromVbr
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例ID。
待迁移的 VBR 实例 ID，须当前直挂在调用者拥有的物理专线下，且为 CreateVpconnFromVbr 指定的同一 VBR
parameters.name: vbr_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client token must be unique among different requests. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token用于保证请求的幂等性。

要保证Client Token在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without associating the VBR instance with shared Express Connect circuits. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the instance status is correct. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the request ID is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. After the check passes, the VBR instance is directly associated with shared Express Connect circuits
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送检查请求，不会关联VBR实例至共享专线。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、实例状态。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回请求ID。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接关联VBR实例至共享专线
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the shared Express Connect circuits.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享专线所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

VirtualPhysicalConnection.description_en: The shared Express Connect circuits instance ID
